title: Object: Billing (E5)
description: Commercial settlement terms of a deal. Lives in Deal.billing (target) or Deal.ext.billing (transition). If omitted, model = 1 (standard) is assumed.

model.description: List: Billing Models. 1 = standard, 2 = direct, 3 = dsp_direct, 500+ = exchange-specific.

party.description: List: Billing Parties. 1 = media owner/publisher, 2 = sales house, 3 = exchange/SSP, 4 = bidder/DSP, 5 = agency, 6 = advertiser.

ioref.description: IO / booking reference known to both contracting parties.

pricebasis.description: 1 = net media price, 2 = gross incl. agency commission.

techfee.description: 0 = n/a, 1 = exchange -> seller, 2 = exchange -> bidder, 3 = bidder -> buyer, 4 = as agreed in the IO.
